AXIOMS #print axioms on all key results: only [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

WHAT IS PROVED (namespace LeanFormal.IUT.XiFPaper.S1850RefuteS1756Actual):
* S1850Doubled: a uniform doubled base-change presentation of the identity map of the S1726 orbicurve at EVERY test scheme T and point q: pullbackScheme T⨿T, projection = fold, toSource = fold≫q, with a full EtalePseudofunctorSquare.TwoPullbackWitness (S1850Witness). No `if` on point equality (that is why S1845Dev fails); everything is definitional.
* S1850Fold_finite / S1850Fold_etale => S1850DoubledFiniteEtale : EtaleStackFiniteEtaleMorphism (id), hence S1850DoubledCover : S1728Cover = OrbicurveFiniteEtaleCover.
* S1850SameSource : S1850DoubledCover.source = S1839TerminalCover.source (rfl); S1850SameMap : HEq ...map ...map (HEq.rfl) — SAME source/map as the terminal cover.
* S1850Model / S1850ModelOver (both rfl): identity-point model = Spec R' ⨿ Spec R'; structure map = fold.
* S1850End_direct (rfl!): S1756End S1850DoubledCover = fold ≫ inl.
* S1850FoldInl_ne_id : fold≫inl ≠ 1 (point argument at inr x, Nontrivial R' from S1844, inl_ne_inr).
* S1850End_ne : S1756End S1850DoubledCover ≠ 1 (S1733Model ...).
* S1850_not_firstMissing : ¬ S1756FirstMissing.
* Cross-model transport: ¬ S1841FirstMissing, ¬ S1845AlgEndTarget, ¬ S1831AlgFirstMissing, ¬ S1743SourceRetraction.
* S1850NoUnit : ¬ S1756Unit S1850DoubledCover; S1850NoRetraction : no one-sided inverse.
* S1850Fold_not_iso : ¬ IsIso fold; S1850Presentations_not_unique: the canonical presentation of the SAME map at the SAME point has projection 1 (iso) while the doubled one has projection fold (non-iso), and both satisfy the recorded witness.
* Contrast: S1850SameSourceMap_differentEnd = (S1756End terminal = 1) ∧ (S1756End doubled ≠ 1).

EXACT DIAGNOSIS (honest boundary, in the file docstring):
The counterexample is produced by the RECORDED definitions, not an added axiom. EtaleStackRepresentableMorphismProperty only asks for pointwise base-change presentations (no cross-point coherence), and TwoPullbackWitness records lift + two comparison 2-cells + action on cone morphisms + 2-cell extensionality but NOT uniqueness of the lift / triangle identities. The doubled square satisfies the weak witness although its projection is not even an iso. Hence the recorded cover datum does not determine S1756End, and S1756FirstMissing is false on the actual S1728Cover type. The geometric statement over coherent covers is NOT refuted: the doubled presentation is a legal inhabitant of the project's cover type but is not a coherent finite-etale cover. Exact missing input = S1756Unit (unit 2-cell), equivalently the full 2-pullback property; after strengthening the cover datum by it, FirstMissing holds by definition (S1756Unit_iff_end). So the remaining content is an assumption on the presentation, not a theorem about the weak witness.

NOTES:
* S1845Dev does NOT compile (I ran it: dependent-elimination failures at 348/355/363/364/371/386, wrong arg name at 363, forward reference at 388). It is superseded by S1850; recommend marking retired in the S1845/S1846 nodes.
* I did NOT edit AUDIT_LEDGER.md, coord/STATE.md or coord/queue.md (to avoid clobbering concurrent edits); please append this negative result and update the S1756/S1845 route status. Suggested wording: S1756FirstMissing refuted by the doubled-presentation cover; affine S1756 route dead as recorded; repair = strengthen TwoPullbackWitness / add S1756Unit to the cover datum.
* Consumer: this file can be imported directly; the main refutation is S1850_not_firstMissing.
